newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil closes sharply lower, hit by weather.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil closes sharply lower, hit by weather.

text.p: IPE gas oil closed sharply lower on Friday in thin volume, battered lower by mild weather in Europe and the United States.
"It's the weakest part of the complex and got no support from crude," said one gas oil trader.
The February contract closed down $8 at the psychological $200 a tonne level having fleetingly toyed with $199.50 within minutes of the close.
"We saw below $200 too near the end and there was no chance for it to be tested," said a trader.
Some dealers said they thought there was room next week for further weakness.
"I think we had the suggestion of where we could go come Monday, but we'll just have to wait and see," said one.
At 1745 GMT March Brent was up one cent at $22.43 a barrel, having range-traded for much of the day.
Underlining gas oil's relative weakness to crude was the narrower March gas oil-Brent spread which stood at $4.06 at the close, down 39 cents from a day ago.
